_doc: Social and shady skills (systems/socialSkills.js). Stealth: theftRisk = points off the odds of being caught stealing from a chest or a field; noticed = % less weight each onlooker and guard adds to those odds; lift = % added to lifting a purse (the quick roll and the mark's sense in the street); sight = tiles off how far onlookers see a theft or a deed of violence (and guards hear it); watchDelay = seconds before the watch gives chase after a deed it saw. Lockpicking: pick = % base chance at a lock of difficulty 1 (each step of difficulty above takes lockStep %); reach = the hardest lock you will try at all; minutes = in-game minutes an attempt takes; quiet = % less chance a failed attempt is noticed. Locks (skills.lockpicking.locks): containers of these types in someone else's building carry a lock by a hash of the box and the restock period: byBuilding [min difficulty, max difficulty, share of boxes locked] (default for unlisted buildings; none outdoors); doors: a barred seat's door difficulty by type. Haggling: prices = % off what you buy and on what you sell in a market (and to a trader in person), against the town's merchants' haggling (each level you stand above or below them moves it by contest % a level, never below nothing); bargain = % more on a trader's bargain. Persuasion: talk = added to talk checks (flatter, persuade, prison talk); bribe = % off a bribe's price; bribeOdds = points off the odds a bribed guard reports you; talkOut = % chance to talk the watch out of an arrest for a beating or broken things (less talkOutPerGuardLevel % for each level of the guard's own persuasion above 2). Leadership: power = % battle power of your army; loyalty = % less loyalty mercenary companies lose a day and % less chance they are bought off; crew = morale your ships' crews rest at above the usual, and points off the morale at which sailors desert; companions = % less chance an unhappy companion walks off. socialSkills.legacy: the old flat player.skills numbers (0-10) these take over: the first time, the old number becomes the level (with its fraction of the way to the next); afterwards any rise of the old number by other systems is XP (rate x the step to the next level per point), and the old number is kept at level + share so everything still reading it works. migrateFrom: a skill seeded once from another old number ({ id: { from, share } }; none: Haggling starts fresh, commerce stays its own number for caravans, property and the guilds).

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.desc: Moving unseen and taking what isn't yours: every theft, purse and escape teaches it, a clean one most.

noticed.text: onlookers {a}% slower to notice a theft

sight.text: seen from {a} tile less far off

watchDelay.text: the watch {a}s slower to give chase
watchDelay.show: the watch {v}s slower to give chase

lockpicking.name: Lockpicking
lockpicking.desc: Opening locked chests, desks and barred doors that aren't yours. Harder locks teach more; a botched try may be heard.

pick.show: {v}% at a simple lock (−9% a step harder)

quiet.text: a botched try {a}% less likely heard

haggling.name: Haggling
haggling.desc: Beating a price down and talking one up: every deal on a market teaches it, a big one more.

prices.show: {v}% better prices (against merchants as good as you)

persuasion.name: Persuasion
persuasion.desc: Talking people round: charm, persuasion, bribes and talking your way out of trouble all teach it.

bribeOdds.text: a bribed guard {a}% less likely to report you

talkOut.text: +{d}% to talk the watch out of an arrest

leadership.name: Leadership
leadership.desc: Men follow you: battles, hired companies, a ship's crew and the companions at your side teach it.

crew.show: +{v} crew morale at rest, desert {v} later

companions.text: unhappy companions {a}% less likely to leave
companions.show: companions {v}% less likely to walk off
